design_principles: PROJECT-LEVEL ONLY — bootstrap touches only .claude/, .codex/, .gemini/ inside the repo; never user-level (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.gemini)
Single bootstrap command per agentic tool: `tools/hook-bootstrap/install.sh --tool=claude` (or codex, gemini, or all)
Idempotent — re-running install does not break state
Hook scripts live under `tools/hooks/` (under VCS); settings files reference them by repo-relative path
Hook scripts are Rust binaries where complexity warrants (per Rust-primary directive); shell scripts for thin wrappers only
Each hook declares its purpose + frontmatter for auditability
Bootstrap auto-detects which agentic tools the user has installed; skips uninstalled tools gracefully
Uninstall removes ONLY what bootstrap added; never touches user-level or pre-existing project hooks
